With us, you can. You want Purpose. Growth. Opportunity. People who get it. We are the home of ambitious, passionate, and innovative world shapers. Join our Mechanical & Electrical group and contribute to the systems that keep buildings, infrastructure, and communities running safely and efficiently. As a Mechanical Engineering Student, you’ll support real‑world projects that shape smarter, more resilient spaces — and see your ideas come to life alongside engineers who are energizing the future of M&E design. * Perform calculations, modelling, and analyses that inform critical engineering decisions.

* You’re building your expertise in Mechanical Engineering through hands‑on academic or project experience, and you’re eager to apply it in real‑world settings.
* You bring curiosity and problem‑solving skills to support mechanical design challenges across HVAC, plumbing, energy systems, or building performance.
* You’re comfortable with tools such as AutoCAD, Revit, or modeling/analysis software — and motivated to keep learning more.
* You thrive in collaborative environments and enjoy working with multi‑disciplinary teams.
* You’re willing to participate in field or site‑based work as required and meet all safety requirements.
You’re motivated by doing work that matters — to buildings, communities, and the world around you.

We exist to shape communities to advance humanity.

* Proudly Canadian – we are a Top 100 Employer in Canada for 2026.
* A global community of brilliant minds – your next idea, mentor, or opportunity is always within reach.
* Limitless opportunities start here. Whether across Canada or around the globe, we’ll help you tailor your path to match your ambition — because your growth drives ours.
* Flexible work, real balance – we recognize the importance of balance in our lives and encourage you to prioritize the balance in yours.

If you're driven by purpose and impact, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now and take the first step toward a rewarding career with us.

  

At **WSP** , we exist to shape communities to advance humanity.
  
  
It’s why we bring people together who are wired to solve complex challenges—engineers, scientists, advisors, and technical experts who are driven by a common passion—to redefine what’s possible and shape what comes next. We are Visioneers.

jobs.description:
De Havilland Aircraft of Canada Limited (DHC) is a storied name in the aerospace industry, recognized worldwide for its pioneering contributions to aviation and its unwavering commitment to quality, innovation, and reliability. Headquartered in Calgary, AB, DHC currently has approximately 2,400 employees across British Columbia, Alberta and Ontario, as well as in markets and distribution hubs world-wide.
  
  
Established in 1928, De Havilland Canada has a rich history marked by the development of some of the most iconic and versatile aircraft ever built. These aircraft have served a variety of roles—from bush flying to commercial aviation—and are celebrated for their rugged durability, operational versatility, and excellence in performance.
  
  
Over the decades, De Havilland Canada has evolved to meet the changing needs of the aviation industry. Today, we are more than just an aircraft manufacturer; we are a comprehensive aerospace company with capabilities that span design, production, maintenance, repair, and overhaul (MRO) services. Our operations are supported by a team of skilled engineers, technicians, and industry professionals who are dedicated to upholding the highest standards of craftsmanship and innovation.
  
  
De Havilland Aircraft of Canada is seeking motivated and technically curious engineering students to join our Engineering team for a 12-month internship. You will work directly with experienced engineers across a range of aircraft systems and disciplines, contributing to ongoing design, analysis, testing, and support activities that keep our aircraft performing safely and efficiently.
  
  
This 12-month internship will begin in January, 2027.
  
  
**Teams You May Work With:****We are hiring across several functional areas, including:**  

* Aerodynamics & Aircraft Performance
* Mass Properties
* Stress Analysis
* Mechanical Systems & Design
* Electrical & Wiring Systems
* Completions & Customer Engineering
* Project and Liaison Engineering
* Ground Test
* Materials & Processes (M&P)

**Responsibilities:****Depending on your team placement, you can expect to:**  

* Assist in the creation and modification of engineering drawings and 3D CAD models.
* Support the preparation and review of technical documents, reports, and compliance analyses for internal and regulatory use.
* Perform calculations and simulations for structural loads, performance assessments, stress analysis, or system sizing.
* Review and analyze aircraft test data, and help investigate in-service or production issues.
* Contribute to configuration management, bill of materials tracking, and engineering change notices (ECNs).
* Participate in design reviews, team meetings, and cross-functional coordination with other engineering groups, production, and customer support.
* Develop tools and scripts to automate engineering workflows or improve process efficiency (in Excel, MATLAB, Python, etc., as applicable).
* Shadow senior engineers and support field investigations, root cause analyses, and corrective actions.

**What We’re Looking For:**  

* Current enrollment in a Bachelor's degree in Aerospace, Mechanical, Electrical, or related engineering field.
* Completion of at least 2 years of study by the start of the internship.
* A strong interest in aircraft systems, structures, and design.
* Working knowledge of engineering tools such as SolidWorks, AutoCAD, MATLAB, Excel/VBA, or other technical software.
* Clear communication skills and the ability to take initiative while working as part of a team.

**What You'll Gain:**  

* Exposure to the full aircraft lifecycle—from design to test to delivery.
* Practical experience working on certification, production support, and fleet sustainment.
* Mentorship from senior engineers and insight into career paths across multiple disciplines.
* The chance to make real contributions to active engineering projects with national and international reach.

Why work at De Havilland?
  
De Havilland Canada is a Canadian-owned and operated aircraft manufacturer dedicated to providing rewarding opportunities in a diverse and welcoming workplace.
  

* Work with a team that makes a true difference in the world-making it possible for people to travel around the globe efficiently, comfortably and safely.
* We’ve manufactured over 5,600 aircraft including the most advanced turboprop in the air today. Our experience and expertise in constructing the highest performing aircraft in the industry is second to none.
* Our state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities are dynamic workplaces led by teams that support and encourage all employees.
* With a passionate team of innovators and a global network of support, De Havilland Canada proudly carries on it’s tradition as a leader in aerospace.

In addition to plenty of opportunities for career growth in a stimulating work environment, De Havilland Canada offers:
  

* Competitive wages

* Extended health benefits (medical, dental, vision, paramedical)
* Life insurance
* RRSP/DPSP Plan

As such, it is expected that all employees maintain strict adherence to Health & Safety Policies and to perform key physical tasks of the position described in the job description and interview process. jobs.description:
**Innovation is in our DNA… is it in yours?**  
Bombardier is a global leader in aviation, creating innovative and game-changing planes. Our products and services provide world-class experiences that set new standards in passenger comfort, energy efficiency, reliability and safety. We are a global organization focused on working together with a team spirit.

**Your boarding pass will include…**

Several conferences, including:

* Meet An Executive
* Meet a Specialist
* Meet a Pilot
* Women Taking Flight

Learning more about Bombardier, including:

* Aircraft 101 conference
* Bombardier Products conference
* Visits of the Bombardier sites
* Bombardier Academy of Learning

Many social/networking opportunities, including:

* Interns’ committee
* Volunteering
* Internal Case Competition
* 5 à 7, Potluck, and much more!

### **What can you expect from your 16 months internship at Bombardier?**

From day one, you will contribute to the delivery of real projects using the latest technology to solve business problems. Over the course of your internship, you will receive one-on-one training and coaching from a team of talented experts and take on increasingly challenging tasks, while learning in a challenging and rewarding environment.

You will be part of the Air Systems Engineering / Pneumatics Systems discipline team where you will be involved in Aircraft Systems Engineering for Environmental Control, Bleed Air, Ice and Rain Protection, Cabin Pressurization, Fire/Smoke detection, Heaters, Oxygen, Flow distribution and Ventilation.

We are looking for a highly motivated Intern to assist aircraft integrators with researching technical issues, data analysis, interacting with various departments, facilitate meetings, progress tasks, maintain governance, and participate in technical discussions, while using various tools.

---------------------------------------------------

* Support Systems Engineering team in investigating technical issues & governance
* Support data retrieval, analysis and presentation using various tools
* Support engineering deliverables & governance by managing databases and following up on outstanding actions
* Support Bombardier Operational Excellence System by tracking Key Performance Indicators (KPI) governance
* Facilitate meetings, create presentation packages, issue meeting minutes in a timely manner
* Develop good working relationships with various departments within Bombardier and with our system suppliers

-------------------------------------------

* Working confidently on your own or as part of a team in a highly technical environment
* Organization and support of technical meetings
* Pneumatic systems and the ability to name components and their functions
* System troubleshooting techniques and procedures
* How to use available tools and databases
* Aerospace component and aircraft certification standards

**What we are looking for:**
----------------------------

* You are a student in aerospace, mechanical, or mechatronics engineering
* You are working towards a Bachelor or Master Engineering degree
* You have an understanding/familiarity in one or more of the following fields: aircraft system design, fluid mechanics, thermodynamics, system control
* You have good oral and written technical communication skills in English (French is an asset)
* You are proficient in MS Office suite, especially Office365 applications and PowerBI
* You possess good interpersonal skills in order to work well within the team and other groups
* You are comfortable with the technical aspects of engineering as well as project management
* You are able to work well independently and demonstrate drive and initiative to achieve the goals established
* Previous technical work experience is an asset
* Familiarity of component qualification (DO-160, MIL-STD-810) and airworthiness regulations (CAR 525, FAR 25 & CS 25) is an asset

**Boarding Information:**

* Location: Global 7500/8000
* Duration: 16 months
* Flexible workplace-Hybrid

*It is important to note that our internship opportunities are open to students only, not new graduates. The base salary for this position is expected to range from CAD $17.95 to CAD $31.00 per hour. The applicable base salary will be determined based on various criteria, at Bombardier’s sole discretion, such as the candidate’s skills, experience and qualifications. All our interns may be required to occasionally travel outside of Canada for training/work purpose.*
